name: Red timeline
what: The picture turns a dark red film grade and an editing timeline rises in at the bottom: three tracks of clips that light up red as a glowing playhead runs across them. At the top a blinking REC dot with a running timecode, a big title and a red line under it.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f10 the REC dot + timecode, the title and the sub line slide in from 8 % of the width to the left (slow end, seen within 2 f); f2-f13 the timeline panel rises in from 16 % of the height lower (slow end); the playhead runs from 4 % to 96 % of the tracks over 95 % of the length (steady, a ticker) and each clip lights up red with a glow over ~3 f as it reaches it; the REC dot blinks 2.5 times a second and the timecode counts frame by frame from the tc setting; the last 8 f it fades, the panel sinking 40 px and the top sliding back (accelerating). The grade companion fades the red film look in and out over 0.3 s

tracks.name: top in
tracks.what: REC + timecode, the title and the sub line slide in

tracks.name: panel in
tracks.what: the timeline panel rises in at the bottom

tracks.name: playhead
tracks.what: the playhead runs across, the clips light up red as it reaches them

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: it all fades, the panel sinks

min_why: the playhead needs a moment to run across the clips
